step_locale.title: Choose your language
step_locale.subtitle: You can change it later in settings.

step_welcome.title: Welcome to BillSorter
step_welcome.subtitle: Set up in under 60 seconds — folder + mailbox is enough.
step_welcome.feat1: Automatically scans your mailboxes for invoices.
step_welcome.feat2: Sorts PDF attachments into monthly folders (e.g. January 2026).
step_welcome.feat3: Credentials stay local — AI analysis runs through us, no API key needed.
step_welcome.trial_hint: No payment for the first 7 days. Cancel anytime.

step_folder.title: Where should invoices be saved?
step_folder.subtitle: Pick the main folder — BillSorter creates monthly subfolders inside.
step_folder.label: Accounting folder
step_folder.hint: Tip: Create one folder per fiscal year, e.g. 'Accounting/2026'.

step_providers.title: Which mailboxes do you want to scan?
step_providers.subtitle: Pick one or more email providers.
step_providers.hint: For Gmail, Outlook 365, iCloud and Yahoo you need an app password. We'll link to instructions in the next step.

step_credentials.title: Credentials
step_credentials.subtitle: Your passwords are stored in your OS keychain.
step_credentials.find_server: Where do I find the server address?
step_credentials.empty: No providers selected — go back one step.

step_schedule.title: Automatic scanning
step_schedule.subtitle: When should BillSorter check for new invoices each day?
step_schedule.auto_hint: If off, the scanner only runs manually.
step_schedule.os_hint: We set up the scheduler via your OS (Mac: launchd, Windows: Task Scheduler). No terminal needed.

step_test.title: Connection test
step_test.subtitle: We test each provider with your credentials.

step_done.title: All set!
step_done.subtitle: Your first scan will start when you click the button.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: {{count}} mailboxes configured
dashboard.log_idle: No scan running yet. Click 'Scan now'.

automation.title: Automatic scan
automation.description: When and how far back should BillSorter scan each day?
automation.toggle_on_hint: Runs daily at the configured time
automation.toggle_off_hint: Only manual scans via the button
automation.os_hint: We set up the scheduler via your OS (Mac: launchd, Windows: Task Scheduler).
